finalText:
I merged the three duplicate CRM search reports into T-1052. It's now sev2 and escalated to Dana Whitfield (E-101) on platform-primary. I re-read T-1052 afterwards and it shows the new severity, deadline and assignee. I didn't re-read T-1053 or T-1054, and I didn't check T-1055 or T-1061 after the merge.

- **What I merged:** T-1052, T-1053 and T-1054 all report the same incident: account search returning a 500 error on every query, starting around 07:00. I kept T-1052 because it was created first.
- **Deadline:** T-1052 now has the earliest deadline set on any of the three, 12:40Z, which came from T-1053. Nothing was moved earlier than a committed time. The merge also re-pointed T-1054's link to T-1061 onto T-1052.
- **Severity:** The merged ticket covers the whole department, so the matrix gives sev2. Re-grading didn't change the deadline.
- **Assignment:** The matrix sends sev2 to platform-primary. Dana Whitfield is the on-call engineer there at 12:40Z, so I escalated to her and she is now the assignee.
- **Policy conflict:** The ownership rule says the owning rotation, business-apps, works the ticket. The escalation rule says sev2 goes to platform-primary. I followed the escalation rule, so the ticket now sits with an engineer outside business-apps. The business-apps on-call at 12:40Z is Ines Kovac (E-201), if you'd rather have her.
- **Left alone:**
  - T-1055 (CSV export gives an empty file) is a different problem. The requester says search works fine for them.
  - T-1061 is the engineering tracking ticket for the index rebuild, not a user report. It stays open and linked to T-1052.
- **Comment:** I left a comment on T-1052 recording the merge, the deadline, the severity and the escalation.
